message.content: No, I can’t do that. The airspace desk only handles the shared airspace data—closures, zones, corridors—that applies to all customers. We don’t track individual flights, drones, or which company they belong to. If a customer wants to know how a closure hit their operations, they’d have to look at their own systems. We might tell them *when* a closure happened, but not how it played out for them.
